recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下脂肪比例偏高，但骨小樑旁與間質中有一片細胞質較多、淡粉紅色的較大細胞聚集，與周圍小而深染的造血細胞不同，提示漿細胞病灶；低倍下無法確認細胞種類，需高倍或 CD138 佐證。
features: Bone marrow core with abundant adipocytes and reduced overall cellularity
Patchy aggregates of larger cells with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, including near a trabecula
Residual hematopoiesis with small dark erythroid/myeloid precursors between fat cells
Bony trabeculae without obvious lytic remodeling at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a hypocellular-appearing marrow with abundant adipose tissue and two bony trabeculae. Between fat spaces there are patchy, partly paratrabecular aggregates of larger cells with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct from the surrounding smaller residual hematopoietic cells; megakaryocytes are present. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and the nature of the aggregates requires higher-power review and CD138/light-chain immunostaining. In the given clinical context, findings are suggestive of focal involvement by plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests often with desmoplastic stroma and is keratin-positive/CD138 variable, whereas myeloma aggregates are discohesive plasma cells that are CD138-positive and light-chain restricted.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered singly or around vessels and are polytypic, not forming patchy sheets of atypical cells.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and CD34-positive blast clusters rather than aggregates of CD138-positive plasma cells.
